description: Find the exact age gap between two birthdates in years, months and days, plus milestones and who is older at any future date.
Solve flow velocity, pipe bore or flow rate from any two, with velocity per bore and head loss per 100 metres.
Convert between torque, force and lever arm in metric and imperial units, with the power at a given shaft speed.
Classify flow as laminar, transitional or turbulent from velocity, diameter and viscosity, with a velocity sweep and regime chart.
Estimate the weight and volume of concrete slabs, footings and columns, with bags of mix and truckload counts.
Convert distance and fuel used into MPG, L/100 km and km/L, with trip cost and a fuel-needed table for common distances.
Get the mean, median, mode and range of any data set, with quartiles, standard deviation and an outlier check.
